problem: Financial KPIs, workforce/productivity, working capital, due-diligence and valuation signals existed as separate portal concepts and did not form one causal management-accounting graph with benchmark-driven roadmap actions.
rootCause: Metrics were calculated page-by-page without a shared causal model from people/productivity through margin/cash/capital to enterprise value. Benchmark context and roadmap effort/value were not bound to the same derived signal.
decision: Create one evidence-first value-driver graph that reuses canonical tenant state, explicit customer benchmarks, the existing roadmap truth and Powerhouse evidence rules. Never substitute generic internet benchmarks for customer facts.
invariants: missing inputs remain missing, never zero
internet benchmarks are context until explicitly stored with source and fit
output per hour is preferred when actual hours exist
working-capital release is cash impact, not EBITDA
capacity value is not automatically cash saving
enterprise value needs sustainable earnings and an explicitly supported multiple
roadmap candidates dedupe on a stable source fingerprint
all derived impacts remain POTENTIAL until realized outcome evidence exists
